description: Send a real reply inside an existing conversation, from the same sending number, on the same project. This delivers an actual message to the contact and incurs cost. Send text (up to 10 SMS parts, or 1500 characters with media), one media_ids entry from the media library, or both; at least one of non-blank text or a media id is required. Without media it is an SMS billed per segment; with media it is one flat-rate MMS. A media id that is not usable returns MEDIA_NOT_USABLE and nothing is charged. Final delivery state arrives on the existing message.sent / message.delivered / message.failed webhooks.

confirm.description: Must be true to run this write operation. Set it only after the user has explicitly confirmed.

media_ids.description: One media library id to send as MMS (see list_media)

text.description: The reply text to send. Optional when media_ids is given

name: reply_to_conversation
